shellCommands.command:
npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &
echo "dev server starting, pid $!"

for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200; then echo "READY after ${i}s" break fi sleep 1 done echo "--- page content (notifications state) ---" curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'Notifications are currently[^<]*[^<]*' || curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oi 'currently.\{0,40\}'

curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/page.html
echo "=== form tag ==="
grep -o '<form[^>]*>' /tmp/page.html
echo "=== any action ids / hidden inputs ==="
grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' /tmp/page.html | head
grep -oE '"\$F":[^,}]+' /tmp/page.html | head

python3 - <<'PY'
import re
html = open('/tmp/page.html').read()
m = re.search(r'<form.*?</form>', html, re.S)
print(m.group(0)[:2000] if m else "no form")
PY

ACTION='$ACTION_ID_00176433f7f112c2e1022642c7a5a84a58e1dcc939'
echo "=== BEFORE: page state ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'currently.\{0,25\}' | head -1

echo "=== submit action (toggle) ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/ \
  -H "Accept: text/x-component" \
  -F "$ACTION=" -o /tmp/action_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"

echo "=== state in action RSC response ==="
grep -o 'currently.\{0,25\}' /tmp/action_resp.txt | head -1
grep -o 'OFF\|ON' /tmp/action_resp.txt | head -1

echo "=== AFTER: re-fetched page state ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'currently.\{0,25\}' | head -1

ACTION='$ACTION_ID_00176433f7f112c2e1022642c7a5a84a58e1dcc939'
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/ -H "Accept: text/x-component" -F "$ACTION=" -o /dev/null -w "toggle#2 HTTP %{http_code}\n"
echo "state after 2nd toggle:"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'currently.\{0,25\}' | head -1
echo "dev log errors (if any):"; grep -iE 'error|warn' /tmp/nextdev.log | grep -vi 'telemetry' | head
kill 1019 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo "dev server stopped"
